notes.title: An All-New Polyroll Adventure: Polyroll Pocket!
notes.content:
Polyroll is back for an all new adventure! This time he'll go where no Polyroll has gone before: Space! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to reclaim the stolen batteries, power up your rocket ship, and blast off for the final confrontation!

[list]
[*] Polyroll Returns: More platforming action packed with a plethora of secrets to uncover!

[*] 24 Stages: Jump, Spin, Fly, and even pilot a submarine in a pocket-sized quest!

[*] Talk of the town: Shop, chat, and discover the entrances to 6 unique worlds.

[*] Battle the Bosses: Reclaim the stolen power sources to your rocket from Kiwi's goons!

[*] 8-bit action: Inspired by classic 90s handheld adventures 
[/list]

Be sure to wishlist Polyroll Pocket now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436130/Polyroll_Pocket/

notes.title: Polyroll, Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30742693/02c3834eebc4d045ddb155e24f1309670cd64c9f.gif[/img]

Polyroll, the roly poly with attitude, uses his super shell to spin, bounce, roll, and ricochet across the land on a mission to save his friends from the clutches of the evil Kaiser Kiwi. Polyroll’s colorful bug-themed world is infused with retro charm inspired by classic platformers and chock full of inventive hazards and enemies. Eleven insane bosses stand between the hero and his friends, including a crazed stoplight, haywire appliances, and a giant spider stuck in a computer case. With locked-away paths and 96 hidden gems, there will be plenty of incentive to revisit the game’s levels to uncover branching paths and secret areas.

Owner's of Clash Force can use the "Complete the Bundle" feature to get Polyroll at a discount! What are you waiting for? Get Rolling!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/743850/Polyroll/

notes.title: Clash Force International Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30742693/ab581eaedcb495081138e0bec4fde95e53cd9696.gif[/img]

We're excited to announce the game now has translations for 5 new languages, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese!

We also snuck in a new CRT filter for maximum nostalgia. Both are in the options menu.

Additional Fixes:
[list]
[*] The perfect run achievement wasn't working in some cases
[*] If you run into graphics issues, you can now run the game in software mode with effects turned off. Just run the game with /DIB as a launch option.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the Gauntlet
notes.content:
[b]New update coming in December![/b]

It's too easy, you said!
We want more levels, you said!
You asked, we've answered. Introducing...

Expert mode and CRACKMAN'S GAUNTLET! A set of 4 brand new, super challenging levels available on hard mode or the all new expert mode!

Look out for these new features in the next update, coming early December!

notes.title: Bug Patch #1
notes.content:
Our original release was not granting the perfect run or beat the game achievements. This patch fixes that. If you already beat the game and still have your save file, you will be auto-granted these achievements upon starting the game. If you hadn't, well now it's actually possible. Have at it!

Additional Changes:
[list]
[*] Added unused tracks from the Soundtrack to the game
[*] Fixed pause menu flickering at the start of some levels
[*] A couple non-user facing tweaks
[/list]

We really appreciate all the feedback we've been getting. Keep it coming, we'll be doing more patches in the coming weeks.
